purpose: one append-only path for chart markers, trade log, reconciliation and prop-eval minute equity

units.time: UTC ISO8601 plus derived America/Chicago trade_date and wall time

invariants: one event has a unique key and deterministic process order; bars become known only at close
chart marker fill prices are exact ledger prices, never extrapolated through missing minutes
reconciliation equals sum of signed tick movements minus exactly one L3 round turn per completed trade
unknown stop interval cannot be promoted to an observed fill; stress-bound event references next visible adverse extreme and stays separate
if a stop or flatten is unobserved, mark minute equity as interval/unknown rather than a single fabricated path
daily P&L alone is insufficient for intraday venue-rule simulation; if intrabar ordering is uncertain, simulator reports bound or not_estimable
one immutable manifest hashes this stream and derived chart/log/reconciliation outputs

display_contract.price_chart: OHLC + entry/exit markers + flagged unknown intervals
display_contract.reconciliation_row: one per eligible day including no-trade $0
display_contract.prop_eval: same marked equity stream, with explicit intrabar uncertainty

freeze_blockers: handling unknown interval in primary P&L
